title: DashboardColumns
description: Columns of cards on a dashboard, one per workflow stage, pipeline step or status (To do / Doing / Done): equal-width columns with a title, a count and an accent color, stacked cards, and horizontal scrolling. With draggable, DashboardCard children move between and within columns by mouse, touch or keyboard; the board stays controlled (onCardMove).

support.notes: dashboard-card: a role=listitem wrapper keyed by value with a label for the dragged copy; in a draggable board a long press picks it up (bindlongpress), a capture-phase touchmove moves the copy and touchend drops it. Beta: needs device validation. Touch only; the floating copy shows the label text, not the card's content; interactive slotted content inside a draggable card can also start a drag on long press. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

support.notes: Status column: accent dot (theme or CSS color), title (property or title slot), count badge announced with the title, description, actions/footer slots, role=list body and translated or custom empty text; value keys it for dragging and drop-disabled refuses dropped cards (the drop target gets an outline). Slots cannot be inspected: the empty text shows when count is 0, and each card should carry role=listitem (dashboard-card does). Empty actions/footer slots keep their (collapsed) wrappers. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

support.notes: Region around a scroll-view scroll-x of equal-width status columns: columnWidth, gap, height/maxHeight with vertically scrolling column bodies and a translated label. draggable boards move dashboard-card components between keyed columns (value): board, columns and cards find each other through relations (linked / unlinked), a long press picks a card up, every column and card root is measured with its own createSelectorQuery boundingClientRect, the shared core functions hit-test the finger, a fixed copy showing the card label follows it, a drop line and the target column outline show the position, and the controlled board fires cardmove { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex } (toIndex counts the cards without the moved one; dropping in place fires nothing). DashboardColumn drop-disabled replaces the canDrop function, which WXML properties cannot carry. Beta: drag and drop needs device validation. Touch only (no keyboard dragging and no live-region announcements); the floating copy shows the label text, not the card's content; positions are measured once at pick-up (no auto-scroll while dragging, and the board or a column must not scroll during the drag); scrolling under the finger is stopped by a data-bound catchtouchmove on the picked-up card. No canDrop function: drop-disabled refuses a whole column. No scroll snapping, and fill does not stretch the columns (each column component host is the flex item); device geometry still requires validation. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

events.name: cardmove
events.typeText: { cardKey: string; fromColumn: string; fromIndex: number; toColumn: string; toIndex: number }
events.description: A draggable board dropped a dashboard-card (long press, then move); toIndex counts the target column's cards without the moved one. Dropping in place emits nothing; the board stays controlled.

translationResources.title: DashboardColumns
translationResources.description: Columns of cards on a dashboard, one per workflow stage, pipeline step or status (To do / Doing / Done): equal-width columns with a title, a count and an accent color, stacked cards, and horizontal scrolling. With draggable, DashboardCard children move between and within columns by mouse, touch or keyboard; the board stays controlled (onCardMove).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: DashboardColumns is a labelled, keyboard-scrollable region of DashboardColumn; each column is a group named by its title and count, and its cards (here minerva Cards) form a list. Here cards move with their own actions (a button or a menu); see Drag and drop for draggable boards.

colors.title: Colors and counts
colors.description: color puts an accent dot before the title: a theme color (primary, success, warning, danger, info, neutral) or any CSS color. count shows a badge, announced with the title. columnWidth and gap size the columns; on narrow screens they keep their width and snap while the board scrolls.

empty-actions.title: Empty state, actions and footer
empty-actions.description: actions sits at the end of the header (e.g. an add button), description under it and footer below the cards. A column without cards shows empty ("No items" by default, translated). fill stretches the columns equally when they fit.

fixed-height.title: Fixed height
fixed-height.description: height or maxHeight bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

drag-drop.title: Drag and drop
drag-drop.description: draggable lets the DashboardCard children of keyed columns (value) be dragged: with the mouse, with a long press on touch screens, or with the keyboard (Space or Enter picks a focused card up, the arrows move it, Space or Enter drops it, Escape cancels; each step is announced). The board never reorders anything: onCardMove reports { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex } and moveDashboardCard (minerva-design/core) applies it to your lists. canDrop refuses positions: here "Doing" takes at most 2 cards.

DashboardColumnsProps.columnWidth: Width of every column (a number is pixels); with fill it is the minimum width
DashboardColumnsProps.fill: Stretches the columns equally to fill the board when they fit (they keep columnWidth as their minimum width and scroll otherwise)
DashboardColumnsProps.gap: Space between the columns (a number is pixels)
DashboardColumnsProps.height: Height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)
DashboardColumnsProps.maxHeight: Maximum height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)
DashboardColumnsProps.draggable: Lets the DashboardCard children of keyed columns be dragged between and within columns (mouse, touch long press, keyboard)
DashboardColumnsProps.onCardMove: Called when a card is dropped at a new position, with { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex } (toIndex counts the cards without the moved one): move the card in your data
DashboardColumnsProps.canDrop: Whether a card may be dropped at a position: refused positions show no drop indicator and the keyboard skips them
DashboardColumnsProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the board region
DashboardColumnsProps.aria-labelledby: Id of an element naming the board (instead of aria-label)

DashboardColumnProps.title: Title of the column (also its accessible name)
DashboardColumnProps.value: Key of the column, reported as fromColumn / toColumn by a draggable board (columns without one take no cards)
DashboardColumnProps.count: Number of items shown as a badge next to the title (and announced with it); omit to hide the badge
DashboardColumnProps.color: Accent of the column (a dot before the title): a theme color or any CSS color
DashboardColumnProps.actions: Header controls on the end side (e.g. an add button)
DashboardColumnProps.empty: Content shown when the column has no cards
DashboardColumnProps.footer: Footer below the cards (e.g. an "Add card" button)
DashboardColumnProps.children: The cards: each child is wrapped in a role="listitem"
DashboardColumnProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the column (defaults to the title with the count, e.g. "To do, 3 items")

DashboardCardProps.value: Key of the card, reported as cardKey by a draggable board
DashboardCardProps.label: Name of the card in the drag announcements and, when draggable, its accessible name (defaults to its text)

cssVars.--dashboard-column-width: Width of the columns (defaults to 18rem; the columnWidth prop sets it; with fill it is the minimum width)
cssVars.--dashboard-gap: Space between the columns (defaults to 0.75rem; the gap prop sets it)
cssVars.--dashboard-column-border-color: Border color of a column (defaults to --border-color)
cssVars.--dashboard-column-radius: Corner radius of a column (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--dashboard-column-color: Accent of a column: the dot before the title (the color prop sets it for a custom CSS color)
cssVars.--dashboard-card-gap: Space between the cards of a column (defaults to --space-2)
cssVars.--dashboard-count-background: Background of the count badge (defaults to --surface-color)
cssVars.--dashboard-count-color: Text color of the count badge (defaults to --text-secondary-color)
cssVars.--dashboard-drop-indicator-color: Color of the drop line and of the column a dragged card would land in (defaults to --primary-color)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: minerva-dashboard-column elements in a minerva-dashboard-columns; slotted cards get role="listitem". Here each card moves to the next column with its own button, and the script updates the count attributes; see Drag and drop for draggable boards.

colors.title: Colors and counts
colors.description: color takes a theme color (also the :state(color-success) ... custom states) or any CSS color; count shows a badge announced with the heading. column-width and gap size the columns.

empty-actions.title: Empty state and actions
empty-actions.description: The actions slot sits at the end of the header; empty-text (or the empty slot) shows while the column has no cards; fill stretches the columns when they fit.

fixed-height.title: Fixed height
fixed-height.description: height or max-height bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

drag-drop.title: Drag and drop
drag-drop.description: With draggable, minerva-dashboard-card elements of keyed columns (value) move by mouse, touch or keyboard. The board fires minerva-card-move ({ cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex }) and never moves anything itself: the script moves the card element and updates the counts. The canDrop property keeps "Doing" at 2 cards.

props.draggable: Lets the minerva-dashboard-card children of keyed columns be dragged (mouse, touch long press, keyboard); replaces the native draggable: the attribute turns it on unless it is "false"

events.minerva-card-move: A card was dropped at a new position (detail: { cardKey, fromColumn, fromIndex, toColumn, toIndex }); move the card element or re-render.

methods.focus: Focuses the scrolling region (the arrow keys then scroll it).

props.heading: Title of the column (also its accessible name; or the heading slot)
props.emptyText: Text shown when there are no cards (defaults to the translated "No items"; or the empty slot)

slots.default: The cards (each gets role="listitem" unless it has a role)
slots.heading: Rich title (alternative to the heading attribute)
slots.actions: Header controls on the end side (e.g. an add button)
slots.description: Supporting text (alternative to the description attribute)
slots.empty: Content shown when there are no cards
slots.footer: Footer below the cards (e.g. an "Add card" button)

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: A horizontal ScrollView of columns that snaps column by column; cards move with their own buttons.

drag-drop.title: Drag and drop
drag-drop.description: A long press picks a card up, the board stops scrolling, and the card drops where the finger lifts; screen readers get Move up / Move down / Move to <column> actions on each card. onCardMove reports the move.
